capabilities: Discover projects from existing folders, tags and frontmatter
Record per-day activity automatically from vault changes
Show grid, table and activity timeline dashboard views with filters and grouping
Edit project notes, statuses and fields from the dashboard
Export finished projects and monthly drafts to a portfolio site
disambiguation: Not a general task manager; it tracks projects you already keep as notes, aimed at developers who maintain a portfolio site.
extras: Portfolio export and monthly post drafting are desktop-only. Activity history is stored in the plugin's own activity.json rather than in notes. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track the status and work history of project notes without keeping separate logs or adopting a new folder layout.

relations.evidence: Everything is plain frontmatter, so Bases and Dataview can query the same notes if you want them to.

summary: Project tracker that finds projects from existing notes and shows grid, table and activity dashboards, with export to a portfolio site.
